title: Coordenador(a) de Engenharia | Planejamento
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar a construção e acompanhamento do plano de capex da engenharia e respectivas reprogramações;
  • Controle e gestão dos cronogramas dos projetos de capital da área da engenharia;- Controle das ferramentas de gestão e ações de governança no capex da área da engenharia;
  • Implementar e acompanhar indicadores de performance;
  • Suporte na implantação de um sistema de acompanhamento de projetos de capital.

Principais Requisitos:

  • Curso superior completo em Engenharia Civil ou Produção;
  • Desejável pós graduação em gestão de planejamento estratégico, PMO;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas Microsoft Excel, Power Point, MS Project.
  • Experiência prática em saneamento com gestão de CAPEX, projetos de Engenharia e/ou gestão de obras;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e jornada de trabalho híbrido em São Paulo (Faria Lima e/ou Indaiatuba).

  • Foco em resolver problemas com eficiência e cuidado humano;

title: Analista de RH II - Foco em T&D
description:
Convidamos você para se juntar à nossa equipe global de inovadores.

A Hexing está espalhada por mais de 90 países e somos uma empresa que valoriza a diversidade e a colaboração. Estamos contribuindo cada vez mais no desenvolvimento de tecnologias de energia verde para o desenvolvimento global, com foco em soluções inovadoras para um futuro sustentável.

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico com oportunidades de crescimento, desenvolvimento profissional contínuo e benefícios atraentes.

Aqui na Eletra Energy (empresa do Grupo Hexing no Brasil) você terá a chance de fazer a diferença, trabalhando em projetos impactantes que moldam o futuro. Se você é apaixonado por inovação e sustentabilidade, queremos você em nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

Descrição da vaga:

  • Mapear e alinhar as necessidades de capacitação às metas e estratégias organizacionais;
  • Estruturar e executar o Plano Anual de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento (T&D);
  • Desenvolver e implementar programas de capacitação técnica, comportamental e de liderança (PDL – Programa de Desenvolvimento de Lideranças);
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de treinamentos, incluindo seleção, contratação e acompanhamento de fornecedores, consultores e instrutores, além da organização logística (espaços, materiais, convites, inscrições e registros de presença);
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de T&D, como ROI, NPS, taxa de adesão e eficácia dos treinamentos, propondo melhorias contínuas;
  • Administrar plataformas de LMS (Learning Management System), garantindo usabilidade e atualização de conteúdos;
  • Assegurar a realização e atualização dos treinamentos obrigatórios (ex.: Segurança do Trabalho, LGPD, Ética), em conformidade com legislações e normas vigentes;
  • Gerir e manter registros de treinamentos e certificações, atendendo requisitos legais, normativos e de auditorias (ex.: ISO);
  • Realizar tratativas de não conformidades no sistema interno, elaborando e acompanhando planos de ação corretivos e preventivos;
  • Conduzir programas de desenvolvimento de talentos internos, promovendo o crescimento profissional e retenção de colaboradores;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar programas de multiplicadores de conhecimento, incentivando a disseminação de boas práticas e expertise dentro da organização;
  • Planejar e executar ações de endomarketing, fortalecendo a comunicação interna, a cultura organizacional e o engajamento dos colaboradores.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas afins;
  • Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Gestão de Pessoas, Educação Corporativa, Endomarketing ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência em T&D e/ou Endomarketing, preferencialmente em indústrias;
  • Conhecimento em Plataformas LMS (Learning Management System);
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de T&D (ROI, NPS, taxa de adesão, avaliação de eficácia);
  • Conhecimento em ISO, auditorias e requisitos legais relacionados a treinamentos obrigatórios;
  • Pacote Office intermediário e habilidades com ferramentas de design/comunicação.

title: Logistics Innovation Senior Manager LATAM
description:
Job Title: Logistics Innovation Senior Manager LATAM | Samsung Electronics

Highlights:

  • Location: São Paulo - SP
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE!

Job Description

The professional will play a transformative role in defining and deploying Samsung's Logistics Strategy for Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami) for Finished Goods (all product lines) and Spare Parts operations. Key programs to be carried out by this position include:

  • Long-Term Capacity Planning: Process Implementation and Improvement: Logistics Network Design, Warehouse Infrastructure (including automation projects), Transportation Modes, etc.
  • Cost Efficiency Program: Manage the project pipeline (PMO) and lead analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings (productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation, warehouse storage efficiency, lead time reductions, LSP management, etc.).
  • Process Innovation: Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that support logistics operations optimization and better governance in Latin America (planning, control, analysis).

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Collaborate on the definition and deployment Samsung’s logistics strategy for Latin America, covering Finished Goods and Spare Parts operations across key markets (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami).
  • Implement and improve the “Long Term Capacity Planning” process, focusing on logistics network design, warehouse infrastructure (including automation projects), and transportation modes.
  • Manage the project pipeline (PMO) for the “Cost Efficiency Program.”
  • Lead analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings, including:
  • Productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation.
  • Warehouse storage efficiency enhancements.
  • Lead time reductions.
  • Strong collaboration with Procurement and other stakeholders.
  • Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that optimize logistics operations and improve governance in Latin America.
  • Focus on areas such as planning, control, and analysis to support logistics optimization.
  • Work closely with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners to ensure seamless logistics operations across Latin America.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Procurement, IT, and other departments to drive efficiency and innovation.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate logistics performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Prepare detailed reports on logistics operations, cost-saving initiatives, and process innovations for senior management.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to enhance logistics processes.
  • Lead initiatives to innovate and improve logistics strategies, ensuring adaptability to changing market conditions and customer demands.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders to address concerns, implement solutions, and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to teams involved in logistics operations and strategic initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • Proven experience in logistics, supply chain management, or related fields.
  • Experience in logistics operations and/or projects across Latin American countries (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami; not necessarily in all of them).
  • Experience in network design projects and logistics capacity planning.
  • Familiarity with logistics management software (WMS, TMS), ERP systems, and automation technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cost efficiency programs, including project pipeline management (PMO).
  • Expertise in identifying and implementing operational efficiency improvements and cost-saving initiatives.
  • Experience in applying process innovation to improve governance and operational performance.
  • Ability to prepare detailed analysis, graphics and reports to support and/or make presentations senior management.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage cross-functional teams and drive strategic initiatives.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams, internal and external partners.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency. Power BI is a Plus.
  • Fluent in English (mandatory).
  • Spanish proficiency (mandatory).

Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future

Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact

Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities for career advancement
  • Global networking and collaboration

title: Consultor (a) Técnico (a) Comercial de Serviços

title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose

The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.

⸻

Core Responsibilities

• Financial Control & Compliance

• Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

• Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.

• Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Reporting & Deliverables

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts.

• Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

• Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.

• Prepare and monitor hedge calculations, manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.

• Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.

• Collaboration & Insights

• Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.

• Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules.

• Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.

• Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.

• Business Development & Bids

• Support the analysis of new bids and tenders, with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.

• Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.

⸻

Key Qualifications

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.

• Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.

• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

• Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.

• Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.

• Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.

• Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.

• Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

title: Especialista Clinico
description:

Na Solventum, possibilitamos cuidados de saúde melhores, mais inteligentes e mais seguros para melhorar vidas. Nesta função você impactará na melhoria das práticas clínicas em Key Accounts atendidos pela Solventum, por meio de ações educacionais e treinamentos para promover a adesão a recomendações, standards e protocolos baseados em evidências e desta forma acelerar a adoção de tecnologias Solventum, alinhado com a estratégia da Divisão Medical Surgical.

Como Especialista Clínico(a) na Solventum, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com profissionais inovadores e diversos, contribuindo diretamente para a transformação de práticas clínicas em instituições hospitalares.

Aqui, você causará impacto ao:

  • Promover melhorias clínicas por meio da apresentação de evidências científicas, programas educacionais e treinamentos técnicos em instituições hospitalares;
  • Realizar apoio técnico e educacional para acelerar o fechamento do ciclo de novas oportunidades de introdução e/ou geração de demanda das tecnologias Solventum para o segmento de Prevenção de Infecção em Sítio Cirúrgico (foco em Preparo da Pele e Normotermia) e Esterilização de Dispositivos Médicos (CME);
  • Utilizar ferramentas de economia da saúde para embasar estratégias de introdução de novas tecnologias nas instituições, agregando valor às decisões clínicas e administrativas;
  • Capacitar equipes internas e da rede de distribuição, garantindo excelência técnica e alinhamento estratégico;

Suas habilidades e conhecimentos

Para prepará-lo para o sucesso nesta função desde o primeiro dia, a Solventum exige (no mínimo) as seguintes qualificações:

Qualificações adicionais que podem ajudá-lo a ter ainda mais sucesso nessa função incluem:

  • Pós-graduação em Centro Cirúrgico ou Central de Material e Esterilização ou áreas com afinidade.
  • Experiência com projetos de melhoria de processos, indicadores de qualidade, gerenciamento de riscos e/ou acreditações.

  • Conhecimento de guidelines e normativas para embasamento técnico e científico na elaboração de protocolos assistenciais visando boas práticas em Prevenção de ISC e Esterilização de Dispositivos Médicos
  • As habilidades incluem excelente comunicação escrita e oratória em público e prática na aplicação de dinâmicas de treinamentos.

Deve estar legalmente autorizado a trabalhar no país de trabalho sem patrocínio para status de visto de trabalho (por exemplo, status H1B).

title: Operador de Produção de Painéis I (PCD)

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

title: Human Resource Supervisor
description:
Job Summary

Responsible for human resources management of the company in the Brazilian region. Through formulating and implementing effective HR strategies, ensure sufficient human resources support for the company's business operations in Brazil, maintain good employee relations, guarantee the compliance and high - efficiency of the company's HR management, and enhance the overall HR effectiveness.

Job Responsibilities

(1) Employee Relations Management

  • Regularly conduct employee satisfaction surveys. Understand employees' satisfaction with HR and company management through questionnaires and other means, and strive to improve employee satisfaction.
  • Actively handle labor disputes. Collaborate with the legal department to ensure the victory in labor lawsuits and avoid significant losses caused by losing cases.
  • Ensure the efficient completion of probation - to - regular and contract renewal processes, and safeguard the compliance and stability of employees' employment relations.
  • Strengthen employee compliance management. Promptly identify and correct employees' non - compliant behaviors, and reduce the situations where employees violate the company's interests and Brazilian labor laws.
  • Monitor the turnover of key employees and strengthen the stability control of the workforce.

(2) Performance Management

  • Regularly provide performance optimization suggestions that are recognized by business departments and approved by management to adapt the performance system to the business characteristics in Brazil.
  • Ensure the performance processes are carried out as planned and avoid delaying employee incentives due to process delays.

(3) Training Management

Optimize training content to be in line with Brazilian regulations, job requirements, or employees' feedback. Ensure the optimization can be implemented as confirmed by business departments, and improve the pertinence and practicality of training.

(4) Business Support

  • Regularly conduct talent inventory to clarify the company's human resources structure and support the talent allocation for the business expansion of the Brazilian subsidiary.
  • Ensure the timely completion of salary surveys, make the salary strategy suitable for the local market level in Brazil, and enhance the company's talent competitiveness.
  • Ensure the on - schedule progress of talent mapping work. Use talent maps to accurately locate target talents (such as those with scarce industry skills) and support the recruitment and reserve for key positions.
  • Provide operational optimization suggestions from the perspective of HR management, identify optimization points in the operational processes (such as HR processes and cross - departmental collaboration) of the Brazilian subsidiary, and improve efficiency and reduce costs.

(5) Compensation Management

Liaise with payroll agencies and comprehensively manage salary payment matters for the company in Brazil. Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of payroll data, including but not limited to the calculation and payment of employees' salaries, bonuses, and benefits. Maintain close communication with payroll agencies, promptly handle problems and abnormal situations during salary payment, and guarantee that employees' salaries are paid on time and in full.

(6) Team Management

Effectively manage and empower subordinate specialists (focusing on recruitment, payment, and training) to ensure that they meet the work requirements.

Qualifications

(1) Educational Background

A bachelor's degree or above in human resources management, business administration, or related majors.

(2) Work Experience

Over 5 years of human resources management work experience, with at least 2 years of HR management experience in Brazil or multinational companies. Those with experience in handling Brazilian labor legal affairs are preferred.

(3) Skills Requirements

  • Familiar with local labor laws and regulations and the human resources market situation in Brazil.
  • Possess excellent data analysis skills to evaluate the achievement of various HR indicators through data.
  • Proficient in knowledge and skills of all HR management modules, including performance management, training management, and employee relations management.
  • Have good communication and coordination skills and team management abilities, and be able to effectively communicate and collaborate with different departments and employees.

(4) Language Proficiency

Fluent in Portuguese and English for daily work communication and document processing.

(5) Other Requirements

Have a strong sense of responsibility, good stress - resistance and problem - solving abilities, and be able to work in a complex cross - cultural environment.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Job Summary:

The Junior Accounting Analyst will play a key role in the accounting department, assisting with daily accounting activities and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data. This position is ideal for a proactive and detail-oriented individual looking to grow their career in finance. The analyst will be responsible for supporting various accounting functions, including journal entries, reconciliations, and assisting with month-end closing processes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to learn and develop a strong foundation in accounting principles. The Junior Accounting Analyst will report to the Accounting Manager.

Key Job Responsibilities:

1. Journal Entries:

  • Assist in making journal entries in financial and accounting systems, ensuring transactions are correctly classified and recorded.
  • Record routine operations such as payments, receipts, billing, and payroll, among others.

2. Account Reconciliation:

  • Perform bank reconciliations, and reconcile accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Identify and investigate potential discrepancies, and accurately and timely reconcile balances.

3. Account Analysis and Variance Analysis:

  • Analyze accounting accounts, identifying variations, trends, and anomalies in balances.
  • Prepare account analysis reports and explain variances to the accounting team.

4. Financial Reporting:

  • Assist in preparing periodic financial reports, such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
  • Collect and organize financial data to support management's decision-making.

5. Compliance with Tax and Regulatory Requirements:

  • Assist in preparing the necessary documentation and information to meet tax obligations, including tax returns and ancillary obligations.
  • Stay up-to-date with accounting and tax regulations, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and laws.

6. Support for Audits and Closing Processes:

  • Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing requested documentation and information accurately and on time.
  • Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting close processes, ensuring the integrity and accuracy of accounting records.

Qualifications:

  • Technical or bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Basic knowledge of financial accounting and accounting principles.
  • Familiarity with accounting systems and the Office suite, especially Excel.
  • Analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication

title: Tax Intern
description:
Tax Intern (Base São Paulo, Brazil) - Industrial Focus

We’re seeking a Tax Intern to dive into the world of cross - border industrial taxation, working directly with our team to ensure compliance and optimize tax processes. If you’re a student with a tax - related major, fluent in Portuguese & English, and eager to learn in a dynamic industrial finance environment—this is your chance!

【About JD.com】

JD.com (NASDAQ: JD; HKEX: 9618), also known as JINGDONG (ranks 44 on 2025 Fortune Global 500), has evolved from a pioneering e-commerce platform into a leading technology and service provider with supply chain at its core. Renowned for its supply chain innovation and excellence, the company has expanded into sectors including retail, technology, logistics, healthcare, and more, aiming to transform traditional business models with cutting-edge digital solutions.Learn more about us:

【About JD Industrials】

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.

Our business is to support the development of enterprises from the industrial manufacturing industry through the integrated model of "supply chain + technology + service", and create a B to B procurement platform for industrial products. We provide industrial procurement solutions to more than 7,000 large customers and more than 8 million small and medium-sized business customers. We work with more than 30,000 suppliers of industrial goods, and our platform has more than 40 million SKUs.

Now JD Industrials focuses on developing overseas business, providing one-stop industrial product procurement solutions for enterprises from different countries. Our business has spread to Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East and South America.

Work Location: Paulista Avenue, 2202, 8th floor, CEP: , Bela Vista, São Paulo - SP, Brazil

Work Time: 3–6 months, full-time. Start ASAP.

Apply now or send your CV to with the subject line “Brazil Tax Intern Application”.

title: Especialista em Processos e Dados (Finance)
description:
Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), established in 1851, is a leading global merchant and processor of agricultural goods (also called commodity trading) with more than 22 000 employees worldwide. LDC reported in 2014, the Group started to rotate to Process harmonization, Global Organizations and especially Digitalization by opening a Center of Excellence (CoE) for Finance, IT and HR based in Lyon.

Together with the CoE, the LDC Groups created a Global Finance Team, called FPSO (for Finance Processes Systems and Organization), which is reporting directly to the Group CFO and for which the aim is to:

  • Lead the Finance Transformation of the group
  • Digitalize LDC Processes and organizations
  • Help LDC to rotate to Finance best practices and best tools

In 2018, the Group materialized its ambition by initiated a Global Finance Transformation and Digitilization of its Back Office operations (Accounting, Controlling, Reporting, Procurement). It consists into a:

  • Reshaping of accounting and controlling processes
  • The implementation of SAP S/4 HANA suite including Business Intelligence, ARIBA

As of 2025, implementations have been done in several regions, including countries such as Argentina, Suisse, US, China. The program roadmap ends around 2028 and will be followed by other transformations project on other systems.

The FPSO team consist into an international team of experiences resources with strong expertise in there domain. They act as the keeper of the Group practices and solutions. They coordinate the different on-going project in the LDC world for their respective scope.

Main Responsibilities

The FPSO team is looking for Financial Specialist, who will be in charge of the one or more of the below E2E processes flows:

  • Payment flow (incl. integration with other systems), cash income flows and bank statement
  • Controlling
  • Accounting, fixed assets and months end closing
  • Integration with Consolidation and Reporting

The Financial Specialist:

  • On one side, guarantees the LDC Group practices and processes related to commercial processes
  • On the other side, support countries in their execution but also guarantee efficiency in terms of tools, organisation and processes

This applies in different kind of activities:

  • Live countries support and small enhancements: enhance user experience, provide continuous improvement, be the core model keeper and supervise the delivery of changes, keep documentation up to date
  • Small projects, called “Ad-Hoc”: launch and drive initiatives to improve BOLD
  • BOLD implementations in new countries: act as a referent for CORE processes and data related to his scope. Find the balance between local needs and Group requirements
  • Innovation: support initiatives integrated with BOLD linked to innovation (analytics, automation, switch to paperless)

The Financial Specialist will work for BOLD implementation in new countries, concretely in Brazil rollout (BORA Project), in charge of group of processes related to Finance flows, as well as being responsible for scope and deadlines.

This role requires close relationship with our Business partners, other members of the Program such as PPSO (for procurement), EPSO (for execution), IPSO (for Industry) and hand-in- hand collaboration with our DT&A departments.

On top of his/her activities related to Global Finance Transformation, the Financial Specialist will help the group to switch to other transformation initiative (such as Artificial Intelligence, Business Intelligence, Block chain) by providing his/her functional expertise.

Qualifications

Experience

3/5 years of strong operational experience ideally.

The candidate will have several or more of the below items:

  • Experience from a Finance Consulting or Technology Consulting firm
  • Participation in Finance transformation project either as an internal or as an external resource
  • Experience in working in project mode and ability to perform in various roles from individual contributor to a leadership role
  • Experience in Finance Transformation projects,
  • Working experience in companies dedicated to agriculture or commodity business
  • Experience in working in project mode
  • Experience in international environments
  • Experience in process design and implementation in an IT tool
  • Experience establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with other business organizations; successful experience in working with diverse groups of people in a problem-solving environment
  • Experience and expertise on SAP S/4 for one or more FI submodules or processes

Other skills (Computer Skills, etc)

  • Fundamental understanding of core accounting and finance processes is required.
  • Strong ability to gather & analyze information, define problems and form a plan of action.
  • Evident ability to analyze and challenge workflows, being analytical and synthetic.
  • Exceptional organizational ability with a very strong attention to detail.
  • Must be able to work independently and take ownership of this role.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with other business organizations; successful experience in working with diverse groups of people in a problem-solving environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work under time pressure and result oriented.

Languages:

  • English (fluent)

Academics

Leading business school, Leading Engineer School, University degree in Business Administration with a major in:

  • Information System and/or
  • Finance/Accounting and/or
  • Process & organization management

title: Logistics Innovation Manager LATAM
description:
Job Title: Logistics Innovation Manager LATAM | Samsung Electronics

Highlights:

  • Location: São Paulo - SP
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE!

Job Description

This professional will be part of the Process Innovation Team, that plays a transformative role in defining and deploying Samsung's Logistics Strategy for Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami) for Finished Goods (all product lines) and Spare Parts operations. Key programs to be supported by this position include:

  • Long-Term Capacity Planning: Process Implementation and improvement, Logistics Network Design, Warehouse Infrastructure (including automation projects), Transportation Modes, etc.
  • Cost Efficiency Program: Lead analysis to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings (productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation, warehouse storage efficiency, lead time reductions, LSP management, etc.).
  • Process Innovation: Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that support logistics operations optimization and better governance in Latin America (planning, control, analysis).

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Analyze processes and related data to support the definition and deployment Samsung’s logistics strategy for Latin America, covering Finished Goods and Spare Parts operations across key markets (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami).
  • Run sales demand and logistics capacity analysis to support “Long Term Capacity Planning” program, that involves logistics network design, warehouse infrastructure (including automation projects), and transportation modes.
  • Lead and/or support analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings, such as:
  • Productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation.
  • Warehouse storage efficiency enhancements.
  • Lead time reductions.
  • Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that optimize logistics operations and improve governance in Latin America.
  • Focus on areas such as planning, control, and analysis to support logistics optimization.
  • Work closely with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners to gather information and carry on the necessary analysis of logistics operations process and performance across Latin America.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Procurement, IT, and other departments to drive efficiency and innovation.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders to address concerns, implement solutions, and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate logistics performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Prepare detailed reports on logistics operations, cost-saving initiatives, and process innovations for senior management.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to enhance logistics processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • Proven experience in logistics, supply chain management, or related fields.
  • Experience in logistics operations and/or projects across Latin American countries (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami; not necessarily in all of them).
  • Experience in network design projects and logistics capacity planning.
  • Familiarity with logistics management software (WMS, TMS), ERP systems, and automation technologies.

title: Especialista em Processos e Dados (Commercial Flows)
description:
Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), established in 1851, is a leading global merchant and processor of agricultural goods (also called commodity trading) with more than 22 000 employees worldwide. LDC reported in 2014, the Group started to rotate to Process harmonization, Global Organizations and especially Digitalization by opening a Center of Excellence (CoE) for Finance, IT and HR based in Lyon.

Together with the CoE, the LDC Groups created a Global Finance Team, called FPSO (for Finance Processes Systems and Organization), which is reporting directly to the Group CFO and for which the aim is to:

  • Lead the Finance Transformation of the group
  • Digitalize LDC Processes and organizations
  • Help LDC to rotate to Finance best practices and best tools

In 2018, the Group materialized its ambition by initiated a Global Finance Transformation and Digitilization of its Back Office operations (Accounting, Controlling, Reporting, Procurement). It consists into a:

  • Reshaping of accounting and controlling processes
  • The implementation of SAP S/4 HANA suite including Business Intelligence, ARIBA

As of 2025, implementations have been done in several regions, including countries such as Argentina, Suisse, US, China. The program roadmap ends around 2028 and will be followed by other transformations project on other systems.

This role requires close relationship with our Business partners, other members of the Program, especially with, EPSO (for execution), IPSO (for Industry) and hand-in- hand collaboration with our DT&A departments and Front Office implementation team.

On top of his/her activities related to Global Finance Transformation, the FPSO Specialist Senior Commercial flow will help the group to switch to other transformation initiative (such as Artificial Intelligence, Business Intelligence, Block chain) by providing his/her functional expertise.

title: Lab Technician
description:
Are you our new Calibration Lab Technician with Maersk H2S Safety Services in Brazil?

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute calibration, functional tests, and adjustments on portable and fixed gas detectors.
  • Carry out Zero and Span adjustment procedures using certified and traceable standard gases.
  • Issue calibration certificates in accordance with ISO/IEC 17025 requirements and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Ensure metrological traceability of results and maintain complete records of services performed.
  • Ensure the organization of the laboratory and suggest improvements in the process.
  • Follow the laboratory's calibration methods and procedures.
  • Periodically check the validity and integrity of reference standards.
  • Prepare technical reports and support internal and external audits.
  • Comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations throughout the calibration process.

We are looking for

  • Technical education in Instrumentation, Electrotechnics, Mechatronics and related areas.
  • Previous experience in calibration and maintenance of gas detectors.
  • Knowledge of metrology, traceability, and uncertainty assessment.
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17025 standards and Cgcre/Inmetro procedures.
  • Ability to interpret technical manuals and manufacturer specifications.
  • Proficiency in technical documentation and issuance of calibration certificates.

Skills

  • Attention to detail and focus on accuracy.
  • Organization for deadline control and documentation.
  • Good communication for interaction with clients and support for audits.
  • Teamwork and adaptability to different types of sensors and environments.

Desired

  • Experience in an accredited ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory.
  • Courses or certifications in the field of industrial instrumentation and metrology.
  • Knowledge in the calibration of other instruments (pressure, temperature, etc.).
  • Technical English skills

Responsabilidades

  • Executar calibração, testes funcionais e ajustes em detectores de gás portáteis e fixos.
  • Realizar procedimentos de ajuste de Zero e Span, utilizando gases padrões certificados e rastreáveis.
  • Lançar certificados de calibração conforme requisitos da ISO/IEC 17025 e normas regulatórias aplicáveis.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade metrológica dos resultados e manter registros completos dos serviços realizados.
  • Garantir a organização do laboratório e indicar melhorias no processo.
  • Seguir o método de calibração e procedimentos do laboratório.
  • Verificar periodicamente a validade e integridade dos padrões de referência.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e apoiar auditorias internas e externas.
  • Cumprir normas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente durante todo o processo de calibração

Requisitos

  • Formação técnica em Instrumentação, Eletrotécnica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em calibração e manutenção de detectores de gases.
  • Conhecimento de metrologia, rastreabilidade e avaliação de incerteza.
  • Familiaridade com normas ISO/IEC 17025 e procedimentos da Cgcre/Inmetro.
  • Habilidade para interpretar manuais técnicos e especificações de fabricantes.
  • Domínio em documentação técnica e emissão de certificados de calibração.

Habilidades

  • Atenção aos detalhes e foco em precisão.
  • Organização para controle de prazos e documentação.
  • Boa comunicação, para interação com clientes e suporte a auditorias.
  • Trabalho em equipe e adaptabilidade a diferentes tipos de sensores e ambientes.

Desejado

  • Experiência em laboratório acreditado ISO/IEC 17025.
  • Cursos ou certificações na área de instrumentação industrial e metrologia.
  • Conhecimento em calibração de outros instrumentos (pressão, temperatura, etc.).
  • Inglês técnico.

description:
QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;

  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

title: Sales Training Facilitator (Brazilian Portuguese Speaker)
description:
RAIN Group, an award-winning global provider of innovative sales training and performance improvement services, is seeking contract sales training facilitators to add to our expanding team

This is a part-time, contract role.

Are you an independent sales training facilitator who is fluent in Brazilian Portuguese and English and is looking to align with a proven, time-tested sales methodology infused across a wide and deep portfolio of training offerings?

We are seeking dynamic individuals who are experts in training facilitation and who have experience delivering engaging learning in any of the following industries: technology, manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, or professional services.

Do you relish the opportunity to work with salespeople, sales managers and sales leaders to help them unleash their own sales potential and that of their organizations?

Do you thrive on delivering high-energy, high-impact, active learning experiences that make the participants the stars of the show?

This role is primarily responsible for crafting, delivering, and enabling our solutions in Brazil, with potential to work on select engagements in global settings. Your main focus will be to drive transformation and achieve results for learners and clients by delivering tailored content and RAIN Group IP through training, coaching, and reinforcement, utilizing a variety of delivery mediums.

Role Highlights:

You'll work within our client and product teams and be responsible for partnering directly with clients to execute the delivery of our programs so they achieve mutually agreed client results. This includes the tailoring of content, and the delivery and facilitation of sessions, coaching, and reinforcement.

You'll be expected to

· Drive client transformation and results by delivering world-class programming

· Project manage client engagements to ensure seamless execution, custom design, and details managed/produced on time and on budget

· Master IP knowledge, and be a source for others as an IP expert

· Meet expected KPI for client feedback on programming and facilitation

· Collaborate with internal teams on behalf of the client, accessing project management, development, content, technology to enable successful deliveries

· Maintain professional client and internal communication at the highest level

· Support sales or large-scale projects as needed

· Provide feedback to sales, product, marketing, and client results teams as needed

Desired Skills, Attributes, and Competencies:

Successful candidates are innately curious and creative thinkers with motivational energy who are comfortable working as part of a team. Training facilitators must have a sound understanding of adult learning theory and the use of experiential learning techniques.

Additional requirements include:

· Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese

· Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree

· Training facilitation experience and stellar references

· Demonstrated experience selling and/or leading sales teams

· Outstanding group facilitation and presentation skills

· Working knowledge of MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and modern collaboration software

· Exceptional oral and written communication skills

· Knowledge of the instructional design process

· Ability to adapt and relate to all levels of leadership, management, and employees with ease and enthusiasm

· Ability to ramp up quickly on specific verticals and organizations

· Open to coaching and feedback

· Willingness to travel extensively domestically and open to international travel

· Reasonably convenient access to a major airport hub

· Availability and interest in training in the range of 2-10 days per month (exclusive of travel) depending upon demand

About Us

RAIN Group is a global sales training and consulting company that helps leading organizations improve sales results. Founded in 2002, we are experiencing significant growth and have established a reputation as a world-leader in sales training and consulting.

We take our company values seriously: Client Results, Excellence @ Speed, Openness, and Commitment to the Success of Others.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.

Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)

Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: API Onboarding Operation Analyst (Entry-Level/ Graduate)
description:
About Us:

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

  • Assist in onboarding external API service providers, ensuring smooth and compliant integration processes under guidance.
  • Support API product testing and documentation, helping identify improvement opportunities and contributing to basic feature iterations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., sales, tech) to facilitate communication and track project progress.
  • Help create and maintain product training materials, user guides, and internal knowledge base updates. 5.Learn industry-standard API products and operational best practices to grow expertise over time.

What We Need From You:

  • Bachelor’s degree (Computer Science, Information Systems, E-commerce, or related fields preferred).
  • Basic understanding of API technologies and interest in B2B product operations.
  • Native in Portuguese, with working proficiency in English (able to read/write documentation and handle basic communication).
  • Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in office Tools.
  • Proactive learner with good communication skills for cross-team collaboration.

What Make This Role Exciting:

  • Early-stage business: Opportunity to participate in the initial planning, design, and implementation of key projects.
  • International team: Work with members from 26 countries and experience a diverse work environment.

  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta.
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry.
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience.
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Operations Analyst
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Monitorar, em tempo real, métricas logísticas como tempo de entrega, atrasos e tempo de espera em diferentes zonas durante o turno.
  • Executar planos de ação conforme diretrizes definidas pelo gestor. Escalar problemas para os gestores da operação, apresentando relatórios analíticos e estruturados.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento em tempo real para garantir eficiência, principalmente nos picos de demanda.
  • Assumir, semanalmente, uma função rotativa (ex.: análise de subsídios, revisões de auditoria, monitoramento do clima).
  • Elaborar resumos claros e analíticos ao final do turno, assegurando uma transição eficiente entre equipes.

Requirements:

  • Regime de trabalho: 6x1, com possibilidade de turnos noturnos.

Highlight:

  • Você será responsável por atuar diretamente na operação logística, tomando decisões em tempo real para garantir a eficiência do processo logístico.
  • O trabalho será realizado em colaboração com a equipe de Operações e o Gestor Operacional, especialmente nos períodos de maior demanda.

title: Junior Python Developer
description:
Aditi Consulting - LATAM

Elevate your career as a Junior Python Developer and join a dynamic, innovative team at Aditi Consulting. Our track record of deploying top-tier professionals has earned us recognition among America’s fastest-growing companies. As we continue to expand, seize the opportunity to grow and thrive in a supportive and forward-looking environment.

We are working with the largest locomotive manufacturing company in the West and the third largest in the world, which also produces software for more than 2 billion dollars a year, operates in 50 countries and has 27,000 employees around the world.

This is an on-site position, available only in Belo Horizonte and Contagem

Tasks of the role:

  • Support the development team with basic Python scripting and small coding tasks.
  • Assist in writing simple automation scripts under supervision.
  • Learn how to use Terraform to define and deploy basic infrastructure components.
  • Help with configuring cloud services in AWS or Azure, guided by more experienced team members.
  • Follow instructions to update or maintain existing infrastructure or application code.
  • Participate in onboarding sessions, internal trainings, and technical workshops.
  • Work with Git/GitHub: cloning repositories, committing changes, creating pull requests.
  • Help with writing or updating technical documentation for internal use.
  • Run basic tests and report bugs or issues to the team.
  • Shadow senior developers or DevOps engineers to understand real-world projects and workflows.
  • Participate in Agile sprints and collaborate with a team of innovative engineers

Required Technical Skills:

  • +2 years of experience working with Python.
  • Experience working with AWS and Kubernetes.
  • 1+ year of experience working with IaC (Terraform preferred).
  • Advanced English.

Benefits we offer:

Cell phone and internet reimbursements

Monthly virtual after-office with credit in a delivery app

Quarterly after-office outside the office with the team

Medical insurance (Porto Seguro) – 100% covered for the employee

Meal Ticket

Equipment and work material (notebook and accessories)

Annual Day Off

E-learning platforms

English classes during working hours

Certifications reimbursement up to $500 per year

Savings account at Banco Itaú or Santander Bank

Transportation coverage for 100% on-site work

Join us!

title: Analista de contabilidade sênior
description:
Sobre nós

Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.

Como é atuar conosco

Por meio da nossa área de Staff Loan, você poderá colocar sua experiência em prática em contextos empresariais variados, contribuindo com nosso padrão de excelência em distintas operações e segmentos.

Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Executar rotinas contábeis diárias, mensais e anuais, incluindo controle e depreciação de ativos, variação cambial e fechamento de custo médio;
  • Realizar ajustes e inventários de estoque (cíclicos e anuais), conciliações do ativo e passivo e provisões;
  • Contabilizar despesas, integrar e conferir dados de folha de pagamento;
  • Apurar impostos (IR, CSLL) e elaborar obrigações acessórias (ECD, IBGE e demais exigências legais);
  • Atender auditorias externas e dar suporte na preparação das demonstrações financeiras;
  • Apoiar o fechamento contábil mensal e fornecer informações para reporting gerencial.

Requisitos / Qualificações

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Experiência sólida em rotinas contábeis, apuração de impostos e obrigações acessórias;
  • Excel avançado e conhecimento no ERP Protheus/Totvs.

O que esperamos de você

  • Comprometimento com prazos, entregas e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes ambientes e rotinas corporativas;
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas e execução das atividades;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Responsabilidade, organização e adaptabilidade;
  • Disposição para colaborar com diferentes equipes e projetos;

Benefícios

  • Rede de academias;
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;

title: Gerente de Projetos
description:
Sobre a Bip

Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...

I. Ser a empresa que sempre sonhamos e que sonhamos para sempre

Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

II. Presente em ecossistema inovador

Significa ter e desenvolver constantemente, internamente ou através de parceiros, soluções inovadoras que promovam impactos em nossos clientes e que sejam o pilar de nossa perenidade. Pois só um repensar constante nos manterá atuantes no mercado.

III. Socialmente Engajada

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth , realize your self-worth , and drive global business innovation .

title: Auxiliar Administrativo (PCD)

Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então inscreva-se nesta oportunidade!

Esta vaga é exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD) com atuação na área de Gestão de Pessoas da unidade de Jaguariaíva.

Nosso objetivo é identificar e atrair profissionais cujos valores e competências estejam alinhados com a cultura da Arauco. Você será considerado para futuras oportunidades compatíveis com seu perfil.

Importante: Ao se cadastrar, anexe um único arquivo com seu currículo e laudo ou exame comprobatórios atualizados.

Principais atividades:

  • Acompanhar a contratação e fazer cumprir os serviços de uso comum, tais como: portaria, restaurante, limpeza de áreas administrativas e de passagem, paisagismo, transfers, fretamento de veículos, área de lazer, conforme critérios e normas estabelecidas;
  • Acompanhar os serviços de manutenção predial administrativa, visando a conservação da infraestrutura física das instalações e a qualidade dos serviços de apoio administrativo;

  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Possuir laudo médico ou exames comprobatórios atualizados;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Jaguariaíva ou Arapoti.

title: Commercial Coordinator
description:
1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

description:

A Bram Offshore Transportes Marítimos é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest Offshore e especializada no transporte marítimo de apoio à indústria de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.

Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time de RMC?

Pré-requisitos:

  • Inglês intermediário/avançado;
  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica ou Engenharia de Automação;

  • Experiência no setor marítimo ou offshore.

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar diagnósticos remotos de motores a diesel utilizando sistemas de monitoramento específicos;
  • Analisar dados de desempenho coletados para identificar falhas, desvios ou irregularidades nos sistemas de motores e geradores;
  • Fornecer recomendações técnicas para manutenção preventiva e corretiva, ajustes de operação ou substituição de componentes críticos;
  • Suportar, remotamente ou, quando necessário, localmente, as atividades de manutenção em motores a diesel, garantindo a operação contínua e segura dos equipamentos;
  • Suportar, remotamente ou, quando necessário, localmente, testes detalhados de desempenho e qualidade em motores a diesel;
  • Suportar projetos de atualizações em motores a diesel, incluindo projetos de retrofit, para melhorar a eficiência e a conformidade com novas regulamentações.

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento em processos de manutenção preventiva e corretiva;
  • Experiência em sistemas de motores a diesel, abrangendo combustão interna, sistemas de turbo alimentação, controle eletrônico e injeção de combustível, além de sistemas de refrigeração e lubrificação;
  • Experiência em overhaul, manutenções top-end e manutenções periódicas de motores a diesel;
  • Experiência em projetos de retrofit e comissionamento de motores a diesel.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Negócios
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Acompanhamento, atualização, controle e análise dos principais indicadores do shopping como: NOI, Receitas e custos, L.S., Tx Ocupação, SSS, SSR, SAS;
  • Realização de orçamento anual, planejamento estratégico/comercial, acompanhamento de resultado YTD e Forecast;
  • Apresentação PPT para Diretoria (RMR) e Comitês (Inadimplência, comercial, jurídico);
  • Conduzir as negociações comerciais (renovação, retenção de lojistas, mudança de locatários, discussões contratuais).

description:

ALEC FITOUT, a division of ALEC Holdings and part of the Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD), is a leading specialist in high-end interior fit-out and refurbishment projects across luxury hospitality, cultural, and themed entertainment sectors. We bring visionary interiors to life through precision execution and world-class craftsmanship.

  • Lead the on-site execution of interior fit-out works from start to handover.
  • Coordinate with subcontractors, consultants, and in-house teams to maintain schedule and quality.
  • Oversee daily site activities, progress tracking, and reporting.
  • Ensure compliance with HSE, QA/QC, and client expectations.
  • Manage subcontractor performance and support variation/claim documentation.
  • Mentor and guide the construction team to maintain a high-performance culture.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Freelance Data Analyst, Social + Paid Media
description:
Position Summary

The social + media data analyst role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and analyzing data sets (from organic social/media/website/campaign) to provide actionable insights and aid with data-driven strategies. The role will be responsible for the development of forward-thinking insights derived from social media data (tools like Sprout, Brandwatch, and native platform), digital/paid media data, publisher reporting, and social listening tools to help guide strategy and creative, as well as contributing to the development of the holistic measurement approach for assigned clients and projects.

This is a remote, international contract role with the ability to work for up to 6 months.

Pay range is R$7.000 - $9.000/month.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Identify and ensure alignment on key performance indicators for organic social and paid media campaigns
  • Develop and execute monitoring and measurement plans based on objectives and agreed-upon KPIs
  • Gather data from third-party tools as well as owned channels and native platforms to generate ongoing performance reports and dashboards
  • Analyze data sets (social media–organic/paid, paid media, etc.) to pull actionable insights and help evolve the overall social and media strategies
  • Structure and analyze informative reports and dashboards to aid organic social teams and digital/paid media teams in campaign optimizations
  • Work with publishing partners to structure reporting cadences and delivery dates
  • Collaborate across departments to communicate insights and findings
  • Present key findings and insights to clients throughout reporting cycles

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 1-3 years of professional work experience within an agency or brand setting
  • Must have a background in analyzing data (social media, media, website) and generating reports, as well as using social listening and monitoring tools to derive insights
  • Ability to translate your research & observations into clear, insightful and visually stimulating presentations that tell a compelling story
  • Ability to clearly and convincingly present findings and insights in a way that demonstrates the value of the data and analysis to clients
  • Experience using social listening tools and content publishing tools (i.e. Brandwatch, Meltwater, Sprinklr, Emplifi, etc.)
  • Experience with reporting dashboard tools like Tableau, Domo, and Power Bi
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (preferably in English) with ability to present ideas and information clearly; keen eye for detail also required
  • Experience and comfort level presenting to clients and key agency stakeholders
  • Ability to communicate with English speaking teams is required

Nice to Have

  • Experience using platforms such as Meta Business Suite
  • Experience with Google Analytics and/or Adobe Analytics
  • Experience brand health partners like Kantar Millward-Brown and Nielsen

Other Duties & Responsibilities

  • Partner with Brand/Comms Strategists and Account Managers to communicate the value of social media monitoring and analytics to clients.
  • Lead efforts in developing holistic measurement action plans across all channels for client campaigns
  • Lead investigative efforts for client measurement inquiries (digital and offline)
  • Partner with media team to aid with campaign trafficking, troubleshooting, optimizations, and reporting

Additional Information:

Pereira O'Dell is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participant in the US Federal E-Verify program. At this time, we are not accepting resumes or candidates from third-party vendors.

title: Account Executive
description:
1. Sobre nós

Keeta, a subsidiária internacional da Meituan - a gigante global de entregas - tem a missão de revolucionar a entrega de alimentos e produtos de consumo em todo o mundo. Com nossa crença principal: “Ajudamos as pessoas a comer melhor, viver melhor”, estamos levando a inovação para o palco global!
